# The Living Seed

> A 496-byte signed genome that grows a working, verified AI on whatever device it lands on — from that device's own
> records, offline. Each organ must prove itself on past cases it never trained on (held-out AUC at least the bar written
> into the genome), or it is cut and answers ABSTAIN; an organ with no local data stays dormant and abstains. A genome is
> verified before it is parsed: change one byte and nothing grows. Built one organ at a time, each measured against rules
> sealed before it runs. Organ 1 (the genome and germination) is proven: 9 of 9 sealed rules held, both predictions
> included.

Live: https://sjgant80-hub.github.io/living-seed/
Try it (germinate, ask, tamper, re-run in your browser): https://sjgant80-hub.github.io/living-seed/#try
How it works (traced from the committed run): https://sjgant80-hub.github.io/living-seed/#how
The receipt (sealed rules, verdicts, git order): https://sjgant80-hub.github.io/living-seed/#receipt
Blueprint (genome format, files, the twelve organs): https://sjgant80-hub.github.io/living-seed/#blueprint
For your business (roles, your numbers, security, roll-out, risks): https://sjgant80-hub.github.io/living-seed/#business
White paper: https://sjgant80-hub.github.io/living-seed/#paper
Source: https://github.com/sjgant80-hub/living-seed

## Measured (organ 1, pre-registered)
- Genome: 496 bytes, 4 organs (shop, triage, water, crop), Ed25519-sealed, one canonical byte form.
- Reproduces seed-library's sealed held-out AUCs exactly: 0.815265, 0.952127, 0.747656, 0.753796.
- Offline: 0 network calls over 5 germinations. Tamper: 486 of 486 one-character changes refused.
- Half the history per device (prediction): every organ live, worst AUC drift 0.0054 (bound 0.03).
- Shuffled shop labels (prediction): AUC 0.513084, organ cut, abstains on 4,725 of 4,725; the others answer every case.
- Mutation gate CLEAN 69/69 over the two kernels.
- Data: the shop is real (UCI Online Shoppers, Sakar & Kastro 2018, CC BY 4.0); triage, water and crop are synthetic.

## Not claimed
- Organ 1 does not improve itself, breed or mesh; those are later organs, each measured when it lands.
- No outside adversary has attacked it yet. No maker-key revocation in organ 1.
- The self-model organ's fixed point is not claimed to be consciousness; self-improvement is not claimed open-ended.
